hints: Each segment describes a line on the whole integer domain.
Find the maximum among all lines at every x.
A Li Chao tree can insert each line and answer each integer position efficiently.
analogy: At every position, compare the heights of the competing straight tracks.
example: The lines y=x and y=4-x give maxima 4,3,2,3,4 at x=0 through 4.
algorithm: For each segment form y=ax+b with b=y1 and integer slope a=(y2-y1)/m. Insert each line into a maximum Li Chao tree over integer x from 0 through m. Query every x in order and print the maxima. Use wide integer arithmetic.
correctness: Every input line is active at every queried coordinate. A Li Chao tree retains a line that can win at a position on its root-to-leaf path, so querying that path returns the maximum.
complexity: For n lines and m+1 query positions, O((n+m) log(m+1)) time and O(m) space with a fixed tree.
